# Warnings and findings

:::caution[v3 release candidate, unreleased]

This is the reference for `@obolnetwork/obol-sdk@3.0.0-rc.12`, generated from its source and spec. Names and shapes may still change before 3.0.0, and it is not on npm `latest`. For the released SDK see the [2.x reference](../sdk/index.md).

:::

An error stops `prepare*`. A finding does not. A finding with `severity: 'info'` is for the record. One with
`severity: 'warning'` means the transaction may not do what you intend (a top-up of someone else's validator, a
consolidation into another withdrawal address) or that a safety check could not run, and **`send` refuses it**
([`FINDINGS_NOT_ACKNOWLEDGED`](./errors.md#FINDINGS_NOT_ACKNOWLEDGED), before the wallet is asked) until you acknowledge its code. Most transactions carry
no warning and need nothing: `await obol.send(tx)`.

Three helpers do the work, all pure:

<div class="sdk-table">

| Helper | Returns | For |
|---|---|---|
| `warningsOf(tx, sim?)` | the warnings (`code`, `message`, `hint`, `subject`, `details`) | showing them |
| `warningCodes(tx, sim?)` | their distinct codes | `acknowledge`, once they were shown and accepted |
| `findingsToAcknowledge(tx, { acknowledge, simulation })` | the warnings still open | gating your own wallet layer |

</div>

`acknowledge` is always a list of codes (`readonly FindingCode[]`), typed and documented: hover a code, or a key of
`FINDINGS`, for its meaning. There is deliberately no `true` or `'all'`: a value that would also cover warnings
nobody has looked at is the one thing `send` does not accept. `warningCodes(tx, sim)` is the honest one-liner: it
acknowledges exactly the warnings this transaction carries now.

The helpers are on [send and acknowledgements](./reference/send.md); how an agent should use them: [For AI agents](./for-agents.md).

## Three ways to acknowledge {#patterns}

From the SDK README.

**1. A confirmation dialog (React, wagmi or `obol.send`).** Show the warnings; confirming acknowledges what was
shown.

```tsx
import { warningCodes, warningsOf, type AnyPrepared } from '@obolnetwork/obol-sdk';
import type { Simulation } from '@obolnetwork/obol-sdk/experimental';

function ConfirmDialog({ tx, sim, onSent }: { tx: AnyPrepared; sim?: Simulation; onSent: (hash: string) => void }) {
  const warnings = warningsOf(tx, sim); // [] for most transactions
  const [accepted, setAccepted] = useState(false);
  return (
    <Dialog>
      {warnings.map((w, i) => (
        <Warning key={i} title={w.message} detail={w.hint} />
      ))}
      {warnings.length > 0 && (
        <Checkbox checked={accepted} onChange={setAccepted} label="I understand these warnings and want to continue" />
      )}
      <Button
        disabled={warnings.length > 0 && !accepted}
        onClick={async () => {
          // Exactly the warnings rendered above. With wagmi, send tx.request yourself instead.
          const sent = await obol.send(tx, { simulation: sim, acknowledge: warningCodes(tx, sim) });
          onSent(sent.hash);
        }}
      >
        Confirm
      </Button>
    </Dialog>
  );
}
```

**2. A headless script with a fixed policy.** Name the codes the script accepts; anything else still throws, which
is what you want from a script.

```typescript
import { UNCHECKED_WARNING_CODES, isObolError, type FindingCodeFor } from '@obolnetwork/obol-sdk';

// This operator runs without a beacon node, so "could not check the validator status" is expected.
// Annotating with the kind makes the editor offer only the codes a withdrawal can carry.
const policy: FindingCodeFor<'withdraw'>[] = ['VALIDATOR_STATUS_UNCHECKED'];

const tx = await obol.ovm.prepareWithdraw({ ovm, requests });
try {
  await (await obol.send(tx, { acknowledge: policy })).wait();
} catch (error) {
  if (!isObolError(error, 'FINDINGS_NOT_ACKNOWLEDGED')) throw error;
  // Typed: error.details.codes is WarningCode[], error.details.findings is Finding<WarningCode>[].
  console.error(error.message); // one numbered line per warning, with its hint
  process.exit(2); // a warning the policy does not cover: a person decides
}

// A ready-made list: every warning that only means "a check could not run" (never one about what the
// transaction does). Read it before you use it.
await obol.send(tx, { acknowledge: UNCHECKED_WARNING_CODES });
```

**3. An AI agent.** The agent prepares, reports the warnings to its operator and sends only with the codes the
operator accepted. It never acknowledges on its own.

```typescript
import { warningsOf, warningCodes, FINDINGS, type WarningCode } from '@obolnetwork/obol-sdk';

const tx = await obol.ovm.prepareConsolidate({ ovm, requests });
const sim = await obol.experimental.simulate(tx, { from: account });
const warnings = warningsOf(tx, sim);

let accepted: WarningCode[] = [];
if (warnings.length > 0) {
  // Report in the operator's terms: what it is, what it means, what accepting it accepts.
  const report = warnings.map(w => ({
    code: w.code,
    message: w.message,
    about: w.subject,
    meaning: FINDINGS[w.code].meaning,
    beforeAccepting: FINDINGS[w.code].guidance,
  }));
  accepted = await askOperator(report); // the codes the operator accepted; [] to stop
  if (accepted.length === 0) throw new Error('Operator declined');
}
// If the operator accepted only some, send throws FINDINGS_NOT_ACKNOWLEDGED naming the rest: report again.
await obol.send(tx, { simulation: sim, acknowledge: accepted });
```

The same rule, if `send` throws first: `error.message` lists each open warning, `error.details.findings` has them
as objects, and `error.hint` gives the exact call. An agent that reads the hint and resubmits with the codes
without asking anyone has ignored the warnings; the hint says so.

## Risks: the transaction may not do what you intend {#group-risk}

### QUEUED_CREDENTIALS_CONFLICT {#QUEUED_CREDENTIALS_CONFLICT}

<div class="sdk-badges"><span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--warning">warning</span></div>

**Validly signed deposits queued for the pubkey carry different withdrawal credentials; the first one (yours) applies.**

Validly signed deposits queued for a pubkey carry different
withdrawal credentials; the first one applies, and it is this deposit's.
Someone queued a deposit for your validator key with their credentials.

<div class="sdk-table sdk-table--kv">

| | |
|---|---|
| Before you acknowledge | Find out who queued the other deposits. Acknowledge only if you accept adding ETH to a validator others have also deposited to. |
| Reported by | [`obol.deposits.prepareDeposit`](./reference/deposits.md#prepareDeposit) |
| `Prepared` kinds | `deposit` |
| Caller should | find out who queued the other deposits before adding to the validator |

</div>

### TOP_UP_ABOVE_EFFECTIVE_CAP {#TOP_UP_ABOVE_EFFECTIVE_CAP}

<div class="sdk-badges"><span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--warning">warning</span></div>

**The deposit takes a 0x00 / 0x01 validator above 32 ETH; the excess is swept back to the withdrawal address, not staked.**

The validator has 0x00 / 0x01 credentials and this deposit
takes it above 32 ETH: the excess is not staked and is swept back to the
withdrawal address.

<div class="sdk-table sdk-table--kv">

| | |
|---|---|
| Before you acknowledge | Deposit at most up to 32 ETH, or switch the validator to 0x02 first. Acknowledge if the round trip of the excess is acceptable. |
| Reported by | [`obol.deposits.prepareDeposit`](./reference/deposits.md#prepareDeposit) |
| `Prepared` kinds | `deposit` |
| Caller should | deposit at most up to 32 ETH, or consolidate to `0x02` first |

</div>

### TOP_UP_EXITED_VALIDATOR {#TOP_UP_EXITED_VALIDATOR}

<div class="sdk-badges"><span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--warning">warning</span></div>

**Top-up to an exited validator: the ETH is swept back to its withdrawal address, not staked.**

A top-up to a validator that has exited: the ETH is not staked
and is swept back to the withdrawal address.

<div class="sdk-table sdk-table--kv">

| | |
|---|---|
| Before you acknowledge | Do not top up an exited validator. Acknowledging sends ETH on a round trip to the withdrawal address. |
| Reported by | [`obol.deposits.prepareDeposit`](./reference/deposits.md#prepareDeposit) |
| `Prepared` kinds | `deposit` |
| Caller should | do not top up |

</div>

### TOP_UP_CREDENTIALS_FOREIGN {#TOP_UP_CREDENTIALS_FOREIGN}

<div class="sdk-badges"><span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--warning">warning</span> <span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--since">since rc.12</span></div>

**Top-up to a validator whose withdrawal credentials are not the expected address's: the ETH can only be withdrawn to those credentials.**

A top-up to a validator whose withdrawal credentials are not
the expected address's (the OVM, or `expectedWithdrawalAddress`). The
ETH can only ever be withdrawn to those credentials: a donation.

<div class="sdk-table sdk-table--kv">

| | |
|---|---|
| Before you acknowledge | Acknowledge only for a deliberate top-up of a validator you do not control. The ETH cannot be recovered. |
| Reported by | [`obol.deposits.prepareDeposit`](./reference/deposits.md#prepareDeposit) |
| `Prepared` kinds | `deposit` |
| Caller should | send only if funding someone else's validator is intended |

</div>

### OVM_STAKE_NOT_TRACKED {#OVM_STAKE_NOT_TRACKED}

<div class="sdk-badges"><span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--warning">warning</span></div>

**Deposit to an OVM's credentials through the batch contract: the OVM does not count it as principal, so it would later be paid out as rewards.**

Deposits via the batch contract to credentials of an Obol OVM. The OVM's
`amountOfPrincipalStake` is not raised, so this principal would later be
paid out as rewards.

<div class="sdk-table sdk-table--kv">

| | |
|---|---|
| Before you acknowledge | Deposit via the OVM instead. Acknowledge only if the owner will call `setAmountOfPrincipalStake` afterwards. |
| Reported by | [`obol.deposits.prepareDeposit`](./reference/deposits.md#prepareDeposit) |
| `Prepared` kinds | `deposit` |
| Caller should | deposit via the OVM, or have the owner call `setAmountOfPrincipalStake` |

</div>

### PARTIAL_WITHDRAWAL_QUEUE_FULL {#PARTIAL_WITHDRAWAL_QUEUE_FULL}

<div class="sdk-badges"><span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--warning">warning</span></div>

**The beacon chain's pending partial withdrawal queue is full: the request would be ignored and the fee kept.**

The beacon chain's pending partial withdrawal queue is full:
a partial request sent now is ignored and its fee kept.

<div class="sdk-table sdk-table--kv">

| | |
|---|---|
| Before you acknowledge | Wait for the queue to drain. Acknowledging spends the fee for a request that is likely to be dropped. |
| Reported by | [`obol.ovm.prepareWithdraw`](./reference/ovm.md#prepareWithdraw), [`obol.withdrawals.prepareEoaWithdraw`](./reference/withdrawals.md#prepareEoaWithdraw) |
| `Prepared` kinds | `withdraw`, `eoaWithdraw` |
| Caller should | wait for the queue to drain |

</div>

### CONSOLIDATION_CREDENTIALS_DIFFER {#CONSOLIDATION_CREDENTIALS_DIFFER}

<div class="sdk-badges"><span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--warning">warning</span> <span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--since">since rc.12</span></div>

**Source and target validators have different withdrawal addresses: the stake moves out of this OVM and cannot be moved back.**

The target validator has another withdrawal address than
the source: the stake leaves this OVM for that address and cannot be
moved back.

<div class="sdk-table sdk-table--kv">

| | |
|---|---|
| Before you acknowledge | Acknowledge only if the target validator and its withdrawal address (`details.targetWithdrawalAddress`) are yours. |
| Reported by | [`obol.ovm.prepareConsolidate`](./reference/ovm.md#prepareConsolidate) |
| `Prepared` kinds | `consolidate` |
| Caller should | send only if the target validator and its withdrawal address are yours |

</div>

### PRINCIPAL_STAKE_MISMATCH {#PRINCIPAL_STAKE_MISMATCH}

<div class="sdk-badges"><span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--warning">warning</span></div>

**The OVM's `amountOfPrincipalStake` differs from the principal on the beacon chain by more than 1 ETH.**

[`ovm.getState`](./reference/ovm.md#getState). `amountOfPrincipalStake` differs by more than 1 ETH from
the principal on the beacon chain: distributions may pay principal out
as rewards, or the reverse. Not carried by a [`Prepared`](./reference/types/send.md#Prepared).

<div class="sdk-table sdk-table--kv">

| | |
|---|---|
| Before you acknowledge | Have the owner correct it with `prepareSetAmountOfPrincipalStake` before distributing. |
| Reported by | [`obol.ovm.getState`](./reference/ovm.md#getState) |
| Caller should | review deposits made via `OVM.deposit`; the owner can correct it with `prepareSetAmountOfPrincipalStake` |

</div>

### PUBLIC_FORWARDER_HOLDS_ROLE {#PUBLIC_FORWARDER_HOLDS_ROLE}

<div class="sdk-badges"><span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--warning">warning</span></div>

**The owner or a role holder is a public forwarder: anyone can call the role-gated functions through it.**

[`ovm.getState`](./reference/ovm.md#getState) / `getRoleHolders`. The owner or a role holder is a public
forwarder (Multicall3 and the like): anyone can use its roles. Not
carried by a [`Prepared`](./reference/types/send.md#Prepared).

<div class="sdk-table sdk-table--kv">

| | |
|---|---|
| Before you acknowledge | Revoke its roles, or transfer ownership away from it, now. |
| Reported by | [`obol.ovm.getState`](./reference/ovm.md#getState), [`obol.ovm.getRoleHolders`](./reference/ovm.md#getRoleHolders) |
| Caller should | revoke the forwarder's roles (or transfer ownership away from it) now |

</div>

### ROLES_SURVIVE_TRANSFER {#ROLES_SURVIVE_TRANSFER}

<div class="sdk-badges"><span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--warning">warning</span></div>

**A change of owner does not revoke roles: the listed holders keep theirs.**

Ownership changes. The current role holders keep their roles under the
new owner (`details.holders`).

<div class="sdk-table sdk-table--kv">

| | |
|---|---|
| Before you acknowledge | Revoke the roles that should not survive, before or after. Acknowledge if the new owner knows the holders. |
| Reported by | [`obol.ovm.prepareRequestOwnershipHandover`](./reference/ovm.md#prepareRequestOwnershipHandover), [`obol.ovm.prepareCancelOwnershipHandover`](./reference/ovm.md#prepareCancelOwnershipHandover), [`obol.ovm.prepareCompleteOwnershipHandover`](./reference/ovm.md#prepareCompleteOwnershipHandover), [`obol.ovm.prepareTransfer`](./reference/ovm.md#prepareTransfer) |

## Unchecked: a safety check could not run {#group-unchecked}

These are the codes in `UNCHECKED_WARNING_CODES`: nothing is known to be wrong, and nothing was shown to be right.

### DEPOSIT_EXISTENCE_UNCHECKED {#DEPOSIT_EXISTENCE_UNCHECKED}

<div class="sdk-badges"><span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--warning">warning</span> <span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--tag">UNCHECKED_WARNING_CODES</span> <span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--since">since rc.12</span></div>

**No deposit status source: whether the validators already exist, and with which withdrawal credentials, was not checked.**

No deposit status source (no Obol API route, no `beaconUrl`),
so the SDK could not check whether the validators already exist or with
which withdrawal credentials. Accepting it means you checked that
yourself: a deposit to a validator someone else created first is lost
to their withdrawal address.

<div class="sdk-table sdk-table--kv">

| | |
|---|---|
| Before you acknowledge | Pass `beaconUrl` or enable the Obol API so it is checked. Acknowledge only after checking each pubkey yourself (a beacon explorer): a deposit to a validator someone else created first goes to their withdrawal address. |
| Reported by | [`obol.deposits.prepareDeposit`](./reference/deposits.md#prepareDeposit) |
| `Prepared` kinds | `deposit` |
| Caller should | enable the API or pass `beaconUrl` to have it checked; else check each pubkey before acknowledging |

</div>

### PROVENANCE_UNKNOWN {#PROVENANCE_UNKNOWN}

<div class="sdk-badges"><span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--warning">warning</span> <span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--tag">UNCHECKED_WARNING_CODES</span> <a class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--throws" href="./errors#PROVENANCE_UNKNOWN">also an error code</a></div>

**Could not check that the contract was created by the Obol OVM factory.**

OVM writes and distributions. Whether the contract was created by the
Obol OVM factory could not be checked (RPC refused the log scan, API
down). (`prepareDeposit` throws instead.)

<div class="sdk-table sdk-table--kv">

| | |
|---|---|
| Before you acknowledge | Retry [`ovm.getProvenance`](./reference/ovm.md#getProvenance), or use an RPC that serves `eth_getLogs`. Acknowledge only if you know the contract by other means (you deployed it). |
| Reported by | [`obol.deposits.prepareDeposit`](./reference/deposits.md#prepareDeposit), [`obol.ovm.prepareWithdraw`](./reference/ovm.md#prepareWithdraw), [`obol.ovm.prepareConsolidate`](./reference/ovm.md#prepareConsolidate), [`obol.ovm.prepareDistribute`](./reference/ovm.md#prepareDistribute), [`obol.ovm.prepareGrantRoles`](./reference/ovm.md#prepareGrantRoles), [`obol.ovm.prepareRevokeRoles`](./reference/ovm.md#prepareRevokeRoles), [`obol.ovm.prepareRenounceRoles`](./reference/ovm.md#prepareRenounceRoles), [`obol.ovm.prepareRequestOwnershipHandover`](./reference/ovm.md#prepareRequestOwnershipHandover), [`obol.ovm.prepareCancelOwnershipHandover`](./reference/ovm.md#prepareCancelOwnershipHandover), [`obol.ovm.prepareCompleteOwnershipHandover`](./reference/ovm.md#prepareCompleteOwnershipHandover), [`obol.ovm.prepareTransfer`](./reference/ovm.md#prepareTransfer), [`obol.ovm.prepareSetPrincipalRecipient`](./reference/ovm.md#prepareSetPrincipalRecipient), [`obol.ovm.prepareSetRewardRecipient`](./reference/ovm.md#prepareSetRewardRecipient), [`obol.ovm.prepareSetAmountOfPrincipalStake`](./reference/ovm.md#prepareSetAmountOfPrincipalStake), [`obol.ovm.prepareSweep`](./reference/ovm.md#prepareSweep), [`obol.ovm.prepareWithdrawPullBalance`](./reference/ovm.md#prepareWithdrawPullBalance), [`obol.ovm.prepareRecoverFunds`](./reference/ovm.md#prepareRecoverFunds), [`obol.splits.prepareDistributeAll`](./reference/splits.md#prepareDistributeAll) |
| `Prepared` kinds | `withdraw`, `consolidate`, `distribute`, `distributeAll`, `role`, `ownership`, `recipient`, `principalStake`, `sweep`, `withdrawPullBalance`, `recoverFunds` |
| Caller should | retry [`ovm.getProvenance`](./reference/ovm.md#getProvenance) before relying on the contract |

</div>

### VALIDATOR_STATUS_UNCHECKED {#VALIDATOR_STATUS_UNCHECKED}

<div class="sdk-badges"><span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--warning">warning</span> <span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--tag">UNCHECKED_WARNING_CODES</span> <span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--since">since rc.12</span></div>

**The beacon chain request rules could not all be checked (`details.checks`); for a consolidation the withdrawal addresses were not compared.**

Withdrawals and consolidations. The beacon chain's request rules could
not all be checked (no status source, or it lacked a field; `details.checks`
names them). A request that breaks a rule is ignored and its fee kept;
for a consolidation the target's withdrawal address was not compared.

<div class="sdk-table sdk-table--kv">

| | |
|---|---|
| Before you acknowledge | Pass `beaconUrl` or enable the Obol API. Acknowledging accepts that the request may be ignored (fee lost) and, for a consolidation, that you checked the target's withdrawal address yourself. |
| Reported by | [`obol.ovm.prepareWithdraw`](./reference/ovm.md#prepareWithdraw), [`obol.ovm.prepareConsolidate`](./reference/ovm.md#prepareConsolidate), [`obol.withdrawals.prepareEoaWithdraw`](./reference/withdrawals.md#prepareEoaWithdraw) |
| `Prepared` kinds | `withdraw`, `consolidate`, `eoaWithdraw` |
| Caller should | pass `beaconUrl`, or use an API with the full deposit-status answer |

</div>

### SIMULATION_UNAVAILABLE {#SIMULATION_UNAVAILABLE}

<div class="sdk-badges"><span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--warning">warning</span> <span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--tag">UNCHECKED_WARNING_CODES</span> <span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--since">since rc.12</span></div>

**The node could not simulate the request in full: only success or revert was checked, not what it moves.**

The node has neither `eth_simulateV1` nor `debug_traceCall`
(or refused them): only success or revert was checked, not what the
transaction moves.

<div class="sdk-table sdk-table--kv">

| | |
|---|---|
| Before you acknowledge | Use an RPC with `eth_simulateV1`. Acknowledging sends on the strength of the preview alone. |
| Reported by | [`obol.experimental.simulate`](./reference/experimental.md#simulate) |
| Caller should | use an RPC with `eth_simulateV1` to see balance changes and events |

</div>

### SIMULATION_READS_INCOMPLETE {#SIMULATION_READS_INCOMPLETE}

<div class="sdk-badges"><span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--warning">warning</span> <span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--tag">UNCHECKED_WARNING_CODES</span> <span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--since">since rc.12</span></div>

**Some balances or state could not be read while simulating: the changes shown are incomplete and not fully compared with the preview.**

A balance or state read before or after the simulated
transaction failed (`details.unread`): the changes shown are incomplete
and were not fully compared with the preview.

<div class="sdk-table sdk-table--kv">

| | |
|---|---|
| Before you acknowledge | Simulate again, or on another RPC. Acknowledging sends without the full comparison; a missing change is not "no change". |
| Reported by | [`obol.experimental.simulate`](./reference/experimental.md#simulate) |
| Caller should | simulate again, or on another RPC; do not read a missing change as "no change" |

</div>
